limitations: Navigation triangle counts are unavailable (-1): global NavMesh.CalculateTriangulation is intentionally avoided because repeated Editor bakes exposed a Unity 6 native crash. Nonempty bakes are verified with isolated NavMesh.SamplePosition and complete/direct route queries.
Android hardware performance, networked play, and future monster animation/body clearance were not profiled by these Editor geometry checks.
